text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

The panel's composition doesn't point anywhere useful for you. All four members were men, you are a man, and the man they hired is also a man — there's no plausible route by which your sex disadvantaged you here. Raising it would read as grasping and undercut your credibility on the points that actually matter.

Those points are real: no written explanation after two weeks, and a successful candidate whose formal qualifications appear lower than yours. Pursue those instead. Send a dated follow-up citing any policy or statutory deadline for feedback, and ask specifically how the panel weighted credentials versus consultation experience against the posted criteria. If the role was shaped around consultation skills, the posting should show it — and if it doesn't, that's your argument.
